subject: App template for tying Rmd files to Tabs

messages.author: 48f24841e806e6c6
messages.subject: App template for tying Rmd files to Tabs
parts:
All,

I'm currently working on a Shiny application template for work here at Vanderbilt. The main thrust is to include knitted Rmd output into a tab:

https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/TeachingLab

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/jeffreyhorner/TeachingLab/

I would love your input on its construction and implementation. Currently everything works, but there's some CSS rule conflicts right now between R Syntax Highlighting (from markdown) and the default bootstrap CSS, so bear with me.

Jeff
